rationale: The agent submitted a return request for an order (#W4689314) without confirming with the user whether this was the correct order, as the user had specified uncertainty about their order number (#W8855135). The agent should have checked for the correct order associated with the user before proceeding with the return. As a result, the agent acted on behalf of the wrong order and did not adhere to the policy of confirming with the user before taking action.
